scenes.setting: The spire's quarantine cells: a neighbor is purged mid-scream; through the far wall a forty-two-year prisoner — an old exploration captain — recounts finding the first outsider in 2000 years, whose escort ended in every teammate losing control. His name: 'Amon.'
scenes.text_anchor: “He told us that his name was…” … “Amon.”

scenes.setting: Two more days of East Borough: ten to a bedroom, floor-space sold in day and night shifts, filth without sewers — Mike's manuscript grows heavier and the reporter grows quieter
